"""API tests run without a database or OpenAI key: the knowledge tools are replaced with fakes."""
import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from app.api import evidence, health
from app.knowledge.tools import Citation, Hit
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)


def fake_hit(kind="feedback"):
    return Hit(Citation(kind, "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111", "G60_feedback_hackathon.xlsx",
                        "sheet Feedback_Explorer, row 4642 (G60-3695)", "They barely cool anything"),
               "They barely cool anything", {"vehicle_line": "G60", "similarity": 0.71}, 0.03)


def test_health_reports_degraded_without_services(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(health, "check_db", lambda: "not_configured")
    r = client.get("/api/health")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body["db"] == "not_configured"
    assert body["status"] == "degraded"
    assert "postgres" not in r.text.lower() and "password" not in r.text.lower()


def test_search_returns_hits_with_citations(monkeypatch):
    seen = {}

    def fake(q, **kw):
        seen.update(q=q, **kw)
        return [fake_hit()]

    monkeypatch.setattr(evidence.tools, "search_feedback", fake)
    r = client.get("/api/evidence/search", params={"q": "seat ventilation", "line": "G60", "polarity": "negative"})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    hit = r.json()["hits"][0]
    assert hit["citation"]["file"] == "G60_feedback_hackathon.xlsx"
    assert hit["citation"]["locator"].startswith("sheet Feedback_Explorer, row 4642")
    assert hit["citation"]["quote"]
    assert seen["line"] == "G60" and seen["polarity"] == "negative" and seen["k"] == 10


def test_docs_source_uses_docs_search(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(evidence.tools, "search_docs", lambda q, **kw: [fake_hit("pdf_text")])
    r = client.get("/api/evidence/search", params={"q": "Felgen", "source": "docs"})
    assert r.json()["source"] == "docs" and r.json()["hits"][0]["citation"]["kind"] == "pdf_text"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("params", [
    {"q": "x"},                                      # too short
    {"q": "seats", "line": "X99"},                   # unknown line
    {"q": "seats", "market": "MARS"},                # unknown market
    {"q": "seats", "k": 500},                        # too many
    {"q": "seats", "source": "tables"},              # unknown source
])
def test_bad_parameters_are_rejected_before_any_lookup(params, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(evidence.tools, "search_feedback", lambda *a, **k: pytest.fail("must not be called"))
    assert client.get("/api/evidence/search", params=params).status_code == 422


def test_unknown_domain_is_a_422(monkeypatch):
    def boom(*a, **k):
        raise ValueError("unknown domain: nope")
    monkeypatch.setattr(evidence.tools, "search_feedback", boom)
    r = client.get("/api/evidence/search", params={"q": "seats", "domain": "nope"})
    assert r.status_code == 422 and "unknown domain" in r.json()["detail"]


def test_store_outage_is_a_503_without_details(monkeypatch):
    def boom(*a, **k):
        raise RuntimeError("password=secret host=db.example")
    monkeypatch.setattr(evidence.tools, "search_feedback", boom)
    r = client.get("/api/evidence/search", params={"q": "seats"})
    assert r.status_code == 503
    assert "secret" not in r.text and "db.example" not in r.text


def test_stats_sums_the_total(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(evidence.tools, "feedback_stats",
                        lambda group_by, **kw: [{"key": "US", "n": 1594}, {"key": "EU", "n": 72}])
    body = client.get("/api/evidence/stats", params={"group_by": "market_code", "line": "G60"}).json()
    assert body["total"] == 1666 and body["rows"][0] == {"key": "US", "n": 1594}


def test_cite_unknown_row_is_404_and_bad_id_is_422(monkeypatch):
    def missing(kind, id):
        raise LookupError("nope")
    monkeypatch.setattr(evidence.tools, "cite", missing)
    assert client.get("/api/evidence/feedback/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000").status_code == 404
    assert client.get("/api/evidence/feedback/not-a-uuid").status_code == 422
    assert client.get("/api/evidence/spreadsheet/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000").status_code == 422
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
import json
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from app.agents.market_trend_agent import (
    SourceDoc,
    build_result,
    evidence_from_trust,
    infer_trust_tier,
    load_market_trend_draft,
    load_seed_sources,
    sources_from_web_search_response,
)


class MarketTrendAgentTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_infers_trust_tier_and_evidence(self):
        self.assertEqual(infer_trust_tier(SourceDoc("https://www.bmw.com/en/news.html", "BMW", "x")), "oem")
        self.assertEqual(evidence_from_trust("oem"), "Verified")
        self.assertEqual(evidence_from_trust("trade_press"), "Interpreted")
        self.assertEqual(evidence_from_trust("forum_social"), "Unverified")

    def test_build_result_keeps_citations_and_routes_out_of_scope(self):
        docs = [
            SourceDoc(
                url="https://example.com/report",
                title="Market report",
                snippet="Customers increasingly expect faster charging and better route planning.",
                trust_tier="trade_press",
            )
        ]
        draft = {
            "findings": [
                {
                    "source_index": 1,
                    "text": "Customers increasingly expect faster charging and integrated route planning.",
                    "signal_type": "market_trend",
                    "sentiment": 0.2,
                    "assumptions": ["Forward-looking analyst statement."],
                },
                {
                    "source_index": 1,
                    "text": "Price incentives are becoming decisive in the segment.",
                    "signal_type": "market_trend",
                    "sentiment": 0,
                    "assumptions": [],
                },
            ],
            "skipped": [],
        }

        result = build_result("G60", "US", "charging expectations", docs, draft)

        self.assertEqual(result.sources_read, 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(result.findings), 2)
        self.assertIn("retrieved", result.findings[0].locator)
        self.assertEqual(result.findings[0].evidence_level, "Interpreted")
        self.assertIsNone(result.findings[0].out_of_scope_reason)
        self.assertIsNotNone(result.findings[1].out_of_scope_reason)

    def test_loads_fixture_sources_and_draft(self):
        docs = load_seed_sources(ROOT / "tests/fixtures/market_trend_sources.json")
        draft = load_market_trend_draft(ROOT / "tests/fixtures/market_trend_draft.json")

        result = build_result("G60", "US", "comfort trends", docs, draft)

        self.assertEqual(result.sources_read, 2)
        self.assertEqual(len(result.findings), 2)
        self.assertEqual(result.findings[0].trust_tier, "trade_press")
        self.assertEqual(result.findings[1].evidence_level, "Unverified")

    def test_web_search_sources_come_from_citation_annotations(self):
        line_1 = "- Buyers expect charging stops in route planning ([caranddriver.com](https://www.caranddriver.com/a?utm_source=openai))"
        line_2 = "- Owners complain about climate menus ([forum](https://forum.example/t/1?page=2&utm_source=openai))"
        line_3 = "- Voice control is becoming the default ([caranddriver.com](https://www.caranddriver.com/a?utm_source=openai))"
        text = "\n".join([line_1, line_2, line_3])

        def citation(line, url, title):
            start = text.index(line) + line.index("([")
            return {"type": "url_citation", "url": url, "title": title, "start_index": start, "end_index": text.index(line) + len(line)}

        response = {
            "output": [
                {"type": "web_search_call", "status": "completed"},
                {
                    "type": "message",
                    "content": [
                        {
                            "type": "output_text",
                            "text": text,
                            "annotations": [
                                citation(line_1, "https://www.caranddriver.com/a?utm_source=openai", "Sedan trends"),
                                citation(line_2, "https://forum.example/t/1?page=2&utm_source=openai", "Thread"),
                                citation(line_3, "https://www.caranddriver.com/a?utm_source=openai", "Sedan trends"),
                            ],
                        }
                    ],
                },
            ]
        }

        docs = sources_from_web_search_response(response, limit=5)

        self.assertEqual([d.url for d in docs], ["https://www.caranddriver.com/a", "https://forum.example/t/1?page=2"])
        self.assertEqual(docs[0].title, "Sedan trends")
        self.assertEqual(
            docs[0].snippet,
            "Buyers expect charging stops in route planning\nVoice control is becoming the default",
        )
        self.assertEqual(infer_trust_tier(docs[0]), "trade_press")
        self.assertEqual(infer_trust_tier(docs[1]), "forum_social")
        self.assertEqual(len(sources_from_web_search_response(response, limit=1)), 1)
        self.assertEqual(sources_from_web_search_response({"output": []}, limit=5), [])

    def test_cli_dry_run_works_without_openai_or_database(self):
        completed = subprocess.run(
            [
                sys.executable,
                "-m",
                "app.agents.market_trend_agent",
                "comfort trends",
                "--vehicle-line",
                "G60",
                "--market",
                "US",
                "--seed-sources",
                str(ROOT / "tests/fixtures/market_trend_sources.json"),
                "--draft-json",
                str(ROOT / "tests/fixtures/market_trend_draft.json"),
                "--dry-run",
            ],
            check=True,
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            cwd=ROOT,
        )

        payload = json.loads(completed.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(payload["vehicle_line"], "G60")
        self.assertEqual(payload["market"], "US")
        self.assertEqual(len(payload["findings"]), 2)
        self.assertIn("retrieved", payload["findings"][0]["locator"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

class MarketTrendAgentTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_infers_trust_tier_and_evidence(self):
        self.assertEqual(infer_trust_tier(SourceDoc("https://www.bmw.com/en/news.html", "BMW", "x")), "oem")
        self.assertEqual(evidence_from_trust("oem"), "Verified")
        self.assertEqual(evidence_from_trust("trade_press"), "Interpreted")
        self.assertEqual(evidence_from_trust("forum_social"), "Unverified")

    def test_build_result_keeps_citations_and_routes_out_of_scope(self):
        docs = [
            SourceDoc(
                url="https://example.com/report",
                title="Market report",
                snippet="Customers increasingly expect faster charging and better route planning.",
                trust_tier="trade_press",
            )
        ]
        draft = {
            "findings": [
                {
                    "source_index": 1,
                    "text": "Customers increasingly expect faster charging and integrated route planning.",
                    "signal_type": "market_trend",
                    "sentiment": 0.2,
                    "assumptions": ["Forward-looking analyst statement."],
                },
                {
                    "source_index": 1,
                    "text": "Price incentives are becoming decisive in the segment.",
                    "signal_type": "market_trend",
                    "sentiment": 0,
                    "assumptions": [],
                },
            ],
            "skipped": [],
        }

        result = build_result("G60", "US", "charging expectations", docs, draft)

        self.assertEqual(result.sources_read, 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(result.findings), 2)
        self.assertIn("retrieved", result.findings[0].locator)
        self.assertEqual(result.findings[0].evidence_level, "Interpreted")
        self.assertIsNone(result.findings[0].out_of_scope_reason)
        self.assertIsNotNone(result.findings[1].out_of_scope_reason)

    def test_loads_fixture_sources_and_draft(self):
        docs = load_seed_sources(ROOT / "tests/fixtures/market_trend_sources.json")
        draft = load_market_trend_draft(ROOT / "tests/fixtures/market_trend_draft.json")

        result = build_result("G60", "US", "comfort trends", docs, draft)

        self.assertEqual(result.sources_read, 2)
        self.assertEqual(len(result.findings), 2)
        self.assertEqual(result.findings[0].trust_tier, "trade_press")
        self.assertEqual(result.findings[1].evidence_level, "Unverified")

    def test_web_search_sources_come_from_citation_annotations(self):
        line_1 = "- Buyers expect charging stops in route planning ([caranddriver.com](https://www.caranddriver.com/a?utm_source=openai))"
        line_2 = "- Owners complain about climate menus ([forum](https://forum.example/t/1?page=2&utm_source=openai))"
        line_3 = "- Voice control is becoming the default ([caranddriver.com](https://www.caranddriver.com/a?utm_source=openai))"
        text = "\n".join([line_1, line_2, line_3])

        def citation(line, url, title):
            start = text.index(line) + line.index("([")
            return {"type": "url_citation", "url": url, "title": title, "start_index": start, "end_index": text.index(line) + len(line)}

        response = {
            "output": [
                {"type": "web_search_call", "status": "completed"},
                {
                    "type": "message",
                    "content": [
                        {
                            "type": "output_text",
                            "text": text,
                            "annotations": [
                                citation(line_1, "https://www.caranddriver.com/a?utm_source=openai", "Sedan trends"),
                                citation(line_2, "https://forum.example/t/1?page=2&utm_source=openai", "Thread"),
                                citation(line_3, "https://www.caranddriver.com/a?utm_source=openai", "Sedan trends"),
                            ],
                        }
                    ],
                },
            ]
        }

        docs = sources_from_web_search_response(response, limit=5)

        self.assertEqual([d.url for d in docs], ["https://www.caranddriver.com/a", "https://forum.example/t/1?page=2"])
        self.assertEqual(docs[0].title, "Sedan trends")
        self.assertEqual(
            docs[0].snippet,
            "Buyers expect charging stops in route planning\nVoice control is becoming the default",
        )
        self.assertEqual(infer_trust_tier(docs[0]), "trade_press")
        self.assertEqual(infer_trust_tier(docs[1]), "forum_social")
        self.assertEqual(len(sources_from_web_search_response(response, limit=1)), 1)
        self.assertEqual(sources_from_web_search_response({"output": []}, limit=5), [])

    def test_cli_dry_run_works_without_openai_or_database(self):
        completed = subprocess.run(
            [
                sys.executable,
                "-m",
                "app.agents.market_trend_agent",
                "comfort trends",
                "--vehicle-line",
                "G60",
                "--market",
                "US",
                "--seed-sources",
                str(ROOT / "tests/fixtures/market_trend_sources.json"),
                "--draft-json",
                str(ROOT / "tests/fixtures/market_trend_draft.json"),
                "--dry-run",
            ],
            check=True,
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            cwd=ROOT,
        )

        payload = json.loads(completed.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(payload["vehicle_line"], "G60")
        self.assertEqual(payload["market"], "US")
        self.assertEqual(len(payload["findings"]), 2)
        self.assertIn("retrieved", payload["findings"][0]["locator"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
